patterns.description: As user scrolls within the product section, the active tab switches between For Businesses / For Individuals / For Community, updating the content panel. No explicit timing values present in Figma export.

Tab bar switches between Rapid-Growth Startups / AI-Transforming Companies / Multi-Disciplinary Talent Organizations. Progress bar fills to reflect active tab position. No timing values in Figma export.

Sequential two-column sticky sections where the left panel stays fixed while the right text panel scrolls through service entries. Adapted from formless's sticky scroll pattern to griting's brand world: left panel uses griting's dark green backgrounds (#003620, #1e2623) with brand green accents (#00693e); right text panel uses griting's light surface (#f5f6f5) or dark text (#031f18). Thin vertical rule (#1e2623) divides columns.

Scroll-triggered reveals for major content blocks. Motion sequences narrative: headlines enter first, then media surfaces, then CTAs, then supporting copy. Adapted from formless's cinematic product narrative approach. Uses GSAP transform-only reveals (no opacity:0 in from()) to keep content visible in screenshots.
motionOrder: major media surface or product demo
patterns.gsapPattern: gsap.from(el, { y: 40, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%' } })

buttonTransitions.description: Outline/ghost CTA transitions to solid fill on hover. In griting's palette: ghost state uses rgba(0,105,62,0.06) background with #00693e border and #031f18 text; hover state fills to #00693e with #ffffff text.
buttonTransitions.transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)

opacityLinkInteraction.description: Nav links and icon links use opacity: 0.6 on hover rather than color change. Preserves griting's green-on-dark palette unbroken. Adapted from formless's opacity-only interaction vocabulary.

glassEffect._note: All CTA buttons on partners-page use glass morphism — static style, not animated effect

glowEffect.colors: conic gradient from purple to blue to cyan to pink
glowEffect._note: Hero primary CTA button has decorative conic gradient glow behind it

ambientGlow.description: Atmospheric radial glow adapted from formless's teal/blue hero-to-footer chromatic arc, recolored to griting's brand palette. Hero section glow: deep green (#003620) to brand green (#00693e). Closing/footer section glow: dark green (#1e2623) to brand-green-dark (#00995e). Functions as atmospheric depth, not imagery — no animation, pure static CSS.
ambientGlow._note: Static atmospheric element. All colors sourced from griting color palette. Concept adapted from formless.

gsapRules.safeInitialState: transform-only — use y/x/scale only. NEVER opacity:0 in from(). Opacity:0 hides content before ScrollTrigger fires, causing blank sections on load and during screenshots.
gsapRules.safeExample: gsap.from(el, { y: 40, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%' } })
gsapRules.unsafeExample: gsap.from(el, { opacity: 0, y: 40 }) — DO NOT USE

recommendations: Use transform and opacity for scroll-reveal animations to enable hardware acceleration
Apply will-change: transform on sticky scroll panels during scroll phase only, remove after

_note: griting is the primary brand. All color tokens, typography references, and static effect styles (glass morphism, conic glow) are preserved verbatim from griting. Formless contributes: concrete easing/duration tokens (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) at 0.2s/0.3s/0.5s), scroll-reveal cinematic philosophy, sticky-scroll services pattern, ghost-to-fill button transition, opacity-based link interactions, and ambient radial glow concept — all recolored to griting's #00693e / #003620 / #1e2623 brand palette.
